Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with severe abdominal pain and vomiting

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 24-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their first dose of DemoGluca (dose: 5mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-04-10.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain and vomiting.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
P. Novak (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
